title: Auditing evidence integration for context-dependent therapeutic target prioritization

endpoint_taxonomy.E2: PDAC-enriched dependency; STRATIFICATION OF E1, not an independent validation endpoint (P0-4)
endpoint_taxonomy.E3: conjunctive actionability benchmark (essential AND druggable); a benchmark construct, not clinical validation (P0-5)
endpoint_taxonomy.E3-A: leakage-controlled essentiality; identical to E1 by construction because dropping the druggability conjunct collapses the positive set onto E1 (P0-3)
endpoint_taxonomy.E3-C: out-of-evidence druggability prediction (saturated for druggability-fed methods)
endpoint_taxonomy.E5: historical clinical-target concordance; NOT clinical validation (P0-6); 35 positives from ClinicalTrials.gov
endpoint_taxonomy.E6: PDAC drug-response actionability (GDSC, new orthogonal endpoint)

leakage_free.identity_note: E3-A label vector is bit-identical to E1 by construction; these rows duplicate the E1 column of the benchmark.

candidates.status: prospective computational hypotheses; not validated targets

gdsc_endpoint.definition: Gene is the annotated target of a GDSC compound whose median log-IC50 across PDAC cell lines falls in the most-sensitive tertile, excluding targets shared with the least-sensitive tertile.
gdsc_endpoint.source: GDSC1000 IC50 matrix (DeepCDR distribution) + CCLE line annotation
gdsc_endpoint.leakage_note: Drug-response phenotype is absent from all nine evidence layers, so this endpoint carries no circularity with the druggability annotation used as an input feature.

harmonic_verification.verdict: The V17 CODE implements the standard harmonic mean exactly (max deviation 4.44e-16). The V17 METHODS TEXT is a typesetting error: the numerator lost its '+3' shift. No numerical result changes.
